evidence.quote: For 2025-12-31, holdings fair_value sum is 1,061,901,106; rows with bdc_dimensions_raw ILIKE '%Affiliated Investment%' are 29 rows totaling 416,707,992. Excluding them leaves 645,193,114, equal to the fv_conservation anchor.

For 2025-09-30, holdings fair_value sum is 1,084,215,154; rows with bdc_dimensions_raw ILIKE '%Affiliated Investment%' are 28 rows totaling 414,622,307. Excluding them leaves 669,592,847, equal to the fv_conservation anchor.
Main schedule total: Total Debt & Equity Investments (7) | 148.3 | % | 809,253,307 | 645,193,114.

Affiliate roll-forward totals: Total Controlled Affiliated investments | ... | Fair Value at December 31, 2025 | 308,845,992; Total Non-Controlled Affiliated Investments | ... | Fair Value at December 31, 2025 | 107,862,000.

Example duplicate position: Tabhi Purchaser, LLC appears in the main schedule as Term Loan B fair value 56,634,539 and again in the controlled-affiliate roll-forward as Tabhi Purchaser, LLC (Mondee) Term Loan B fair value 56,634,539.

rationale: The extracted data includes affiliate roll-forward disclosure rows as if they were additional holdings. These rows present beginning fair value, additions, reductions, realized/unrealized changes, and ending fair value for controlled and non-controlled affiliated investments; they duplicate positions already counted in the main schedule of investments. For the affected 2025-09-30 and 2025-12-31 quarters, the affiliated-roll-forward ending fair values exactly equal the conservation overshoot, so excluding those leaked disclosure rows reconciles fair value to the validated anchor without deleting real main-schedule positions.
